info.title: Borrowly API
info.description: API for Borrowly - Item Borrowing Platform

delete.summary: Delete an item with no active borrowing

post.description: Login user and return JWT token.
Logout the authenticated user and invalidate the JWT token.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's information.
Admin only. Return all borrowing requests with item and user information.

post.description: Create a new borrowing request for an available item using today or a future start date. A user cannot request their own item or send a duplicate active request.

400.description: Item unavailable, own item, or duplicate active request

get.summary: Get borrowing requests received for my items
get.description: Return requests made by other users for items owned by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Only the owner of the requested item can approve a pending request. Other pending requests for the same item are automatically rejected.

403.description: Only the item owner can approve this request

patch.description: Only the owner of the requested item can reject a pending request.

400.description: Only pending requests can be rejected

403.description: Only the item owner can reject this request

patch.description: Only the approved borrower can confirm that the item was physically received. This changes the borrowing from approved to borrowed and marks the item as borrowed.

400.description: Borrowing is not approved or item is not reserved

403.description: Only the approved borrower can confirm receipt

patch.summary: Owner confirms the item was returned
patch.description: Only the item owner can confirm that a borrowed item was returned. This changes the borrowing from borrowed to returned, records returned_at, and makes the item available again.

400.description: Borrowing is not active or item is not marked borrowed

403.description: Only the item owner can confirm the return

get.description: The borrower or the owner of the requested item can view the request.

put.description: Admin only. Update the status of a borrowing request.

delete.description: Admin only. Delete a borrowing request.

get.description: Return the borrowing requests of the authenticated user.
Return a list of all categories.

post.summary: Open or create the conversation for a borrowing

body.example: What time works for the handoff?

get.summary: Get favorite item IDs for the authenticated user

get.description: Return notifications belonging to the authenticated user, newest first.

bio.example: Happy to share useful items with my community.

403.description: Not authorized for this report target

post.description: Create a review for an item that the authenticated user has borrowed and returned.

403.description: User has not returned the item

409.description: User has already reviewed this item

get.description: Return all reviews for a specific item.
Return details of a specific review.

put.description: Update a review belonging to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a review belonging to the authenticated user.
